key_findings: Oxymatrine (200 mg/kg) relieved mechanical allodynia in CPSP rats and lowered IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α and microglia/astrocyte markers at the thalamic lesion.
Network pharmacology flagged STAT3, TLR4 and HDAC1 among core OMT targets, with enrichment in inflammatory processes.
